title: Mod Descriptor settings · fields required for Steam Workshop upload
intro: These fields control the descriptor.mod inside the export ZIP (version / thumbnail file / Workshop tags / mod dependencies / compatible HOI4 engine version). After editing, they take effect on your next export; just double-check before uploading to the Steam Workshop.
versionHint: The mod's own version number · used for Workshop update prompts.
supportedVersionHint: Compatible HOI4 engine version (<mono>1.19.*</mono> covers all 1.19.x patches).
startDateHint: Leave empty = follow the vanilla or base mod's start date. Format: Y.M.D (e.g. 183.1.1)
pictureHint: Image filename under the mod root (e.g. <mono>thumbnail.png</mono>) · the Workshop listing thumbnail. Empty = don't emit a <mono>picture=</mono> line.

projectCover.title: Workshop cover
projectCover.emptyHint: The descriptor won't reference a cover until you upload an image.
projectCover.invalidType: Choose a PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, DDS, or TGA image.

tagsHintBefore: One per line · commas also work. Click a chip to quickly add/remove. Emitted as a
depsHintBefore: Names of mods that must load before this one · one per line. Empty = don't emit a

baseMod.addHint: Choose the folder of an installed mod, the one with its descriptor.mod. Its name is added to the dependencies, and the editors show the pictures it defines.
baseMod.noFolder: No folder chosen: its pictures fall back to the base game.
baseMod.folderMissing: Folder not found: {folder}. Its pictures fall back to the base game.
baseMod.pickHint: Open the folder that holds the mod's descriptor.mod, such as a Steam Workshop item under steamapps\workshop\content\394360 or a mod in your mod folder. It is only read, never changed.
baseMod.notAMod: This folder is not a Hearts of Iron IV mod: it has no descriptor.mod with a mod name. Choose the folder that holds descriptor.mod.

langsHint: Which languages your mod exports to localisation/* yml files. English is always emitted (HOI4 engine fallback). Adding more languages exposes per-language tabs in entity editors.
savedIndicator: ✓ Saved. Takes effect on your next export.
